package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.behaviors

import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.FundQuotaEntity._

object FundQuotaEventHandler extends EventHandler {
  override def apply(state: State, input: Event): State = input match {
    case event: SubscriptionQuotaReserved =>
      state.copy(
        fundTotalUsed = (state.fundTotalUsed + event.amount),
        accountUsed = state.accountUsed.updated(event.accountId, (state.accountUsed.getOrElse(event.accountId, BigDecimal("0")) + event.amount))
      )
  }
}
